ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels dominating the medial and lateral lobe surfaces, contrasted against 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity banding along the entire trailing edge and the central peduncle insertion zone. Distinct, high-contrast dark mottling (pixel clusters) is localized on the medial port lobe, with isolated dark spots scattered across the starboard lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 60 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-8 pixels) irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks are most prominent and irregular at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave sweep along the trailing edge moving from the median notch to the outer lobes, terminating in sharp, convexly curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, multi-tonal (brown/white) textured clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the port and starboard lobes, indicating significant barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least three distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the port lobe, oriented diagonally from the notch region toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy epibiont encrustations at the fluke tips and several small, discrete dark pigment disruptions (likely healed wounds) on the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical dark pillar of pigmentation extending from the median notch toward the leading edge, bisecting the white ventral field.
